[size=6]Introduce[/size]

[size=3]The mod allows you to move the viewpoint. The game viewport is unlocked when the keybind ([color=#ff0000]V by default[/color]) is pressed within the game, at which point the mouse moves closer to the edge of the screen to move the viewport.[/size]
